# Northfield Library — Equipment Loan Desk Policy

This policy tells the desk how to handle requests to borrow equipment.

## Rules

**L1 Library card.** If there is no library card, the request is rejected.

**L2 Repeat borrowers.** A borrower with 3 or more overdue loans in the last 180 days is referred to the Circulation Manager.

**L3 High-value items.** A loan of equipment worth more than $1,500 requires approval from the Director; the desk escalates to the Director.

**L4 Approval.** Otherwise the request is approved.
